brief: A 7-second lower-third: a name 'Dr. Ada Park' and title 'Chief Scientist' slide in from the left on a colored bar, hold, then slide out.
checks: Is the colored bar visible behind both text lines for the entire duration?
Does the name text read exactly 'Dr. Ada Park'?
Does the title text read exactly 'Chief Scientist'?
Is the name positioned above the title (vertically higher in the frame)?
Are the left edges of the name and title aligned (same horizontal start point)?
Do the bar and text start completely off‑screen left and become fully on‑screen within the first second?
Does the sliding motion ease in and out (i.e., not move at a constant speed)?
Is there a stationary hold of at least 0.5 seconds after the slide‑in before the slide‑out begins?
Do the bar and text slide completely off‑screen left before the video ends?
Do the bar and text never touch or cross the top or bottom frame edges?
Is the vertical spacing between the name and title even and visually balanced?
Is the text legible with high contrast against the colored bar?
Are there no visible glitches, flicker, overlapping text, or rendering artifacts?
Does something move or change in every second of the video (no dead air)?
